articles.summary: Company Reports Consolidated Revenue of $7.3 Million for Q3 , an 80% increase over prior year. Company's Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Falcon's Creative Group, generated Q3 revenue of $5.2 Million Company's Unconsolidated Joint Venture, Producciones de Parques, generated Q3 revenue of $11.8 Million Falcon’s Beyond Global, Inc. (Nasdaq: FBYD) (“Falcon’s Beyond”, “Falcon’s” or the “Company”), a visionary entertainment and technology enterprise through its three complementary business divisions Falcon’s Creative (“FC”), Falcon’s Beyond Brands (“FBB”), and Falcon’s Beyond Destinations (“FBD”) reported financial results for the third quarter 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenue Falcon's generated consolidated revenue of $7.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, an 80% increase over the prior period.
